entity.summary: Abu Dhabi-regulated virtual-asset multilateral trading facility and custody platform that permanently suspended its trading facility during a voluntary wind-down in January 2026.
entity.notes: Matrix Limited announced a voluntary wind-down and permanent suspension of its Multilateral Trading Facility at 23:59:59 UTC on 2026-01-31. HEI uses that first-party trading-facility shutdown date as the entity death date rather than the later FSRA regulatory-withdrawal date. The ADGM FSRA public register now marks Matrix Limited withdrawn and preserves its former virtual-asset MTF and custody permissions. The root domain remains reachable but was not treated as evidence that trading service continues.

events.title: Multilateral trading facility permanently suspended
events.description: Matrix Limited permanently suspended its virtual-asset multilateral trading facility as part of an announced service wind-down.
events.notes: The terminal service date follows Matrix Limited's first-party wind-down notice. Later FSRA withdrawal dates are retained as supporting regulatory status evidence rather than substituted for the service shutdown date.

evidence.title: Important Notice: Matrix Limited – Service Wind-Down
evidence.notes: First-party notice states that Matrix Limited decided to wind down and would permanently suspend its MTF on 2026-01-31 at 23:59:59 UTC, with deposits already stopped and clients instructed to withdraw assets by that date.

evidence.title: Matrix Limited FSRA public register entry
evidence.publisher: Abu Dhabi Global Market Financial Services Regulatory Authority
evidence.notes: Official FSRA register identifies Matrix Limited, FSP 190019, the matrix.co website, withdrawn firm status, and former virtual-asset MTF and custody regulated activities. The register's firm-level and activity-level withdrawal dates are later than the first-party MTF shutdown date and are not used as the HEI death date.
